thread:
lena: Filing a soft-pin request for runtime v3.2.1 scoped to eu-west. Observed SDK handshake failures with quant-llama3x on longseq (>1024). Repro on canary and small spike in prod. Reverted to 3.1.9 removed the failures. Request: pin routing to 3.1.9 in eu-west until SDK patch is rolled.
mike: Can you paste a short log snippet and failure rate? Is this a kernel mismatch or kvcache problem?
sara: Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/rollups/quant-llama3x-longseq -> error_rate: 1.8% (global), eu-west: 3.9% this morning. Canary run: same failure pattern after ~600 tokens.
lena: log: "ERROR handshake: incompatible_kernel: expected v5, got v4" (truncated). Repro command: run-load-test --model quant-llama3x --seq 1500 --sdk 2.7.2.
julian: If we soft-pin routing only in eu-west, we keep global traffic on 3.2.1. Does deploybot support region-scoped pins? tldr: prefer minimal blast radius.
tina: Agree on region-scoped soft-pin. Also want to confirm Dedicated customers in eu-west are unaffected (we can't change their pinned infra). Anyone flagged?
mike: Dedicated customers unaffected; only hosted routing layer is controlled here.
deploybot: create_pin_request P-9876 created by lena. Details: scope=region:eu-west, target_runtime=3.1.9, expiry=2026-04-01T12:00:00Z, reason="SDK handshake regression with quant-llama3x longseq". Pending approvals: eng-leads + oncall.
ops-bot: runbook link: https://runbook.redwood/pins -> rollback steps: 1) unpin via deployctl, 2) flush routing cache, 3) monitor errors for 30m.
sara: Quick canary suggestion: run 5% traffic to 3.2.1 in eu-west for 1h after pin to ensure no surprise regressions when we unpin later.
julian: Impact on latency/cost? Any slower path on 3.1.9 for embeddings/short seqs?
lena: Minimal for short seqs. 3.1.9 has slightly higher tail p95 on embeddings (~8ms) but within SLA. Cost delta negligible for our customers.
mike: SDK patch PR: https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/4827 (fix: handshake kernels fallback for quant models). CI green except integration tests failing in longseq > 4k.
tina: Proposed plan: apply soft-pin in eu-west in the next 15m window, run targeted canary (5%) for 60m, escalate to wider routing if SDK PR validated. If error_rate does not drop below 0.5% in 45m -> rollback unpin to 3.2.1 and alert SDK team for hotfix.
lena: command to apply (ops-approved):
```
# ops: apply region-scoped soft pin
deployctl pin runtime \ 
  --region eu-west \ 
  --runtime v3.1.9 \ 
  --type soft \ 
  --until 2026-04-01 \ 
  --reason "SDK handshake for quant-llama3x longseq"
```
deploybot: Scheduled: P-9876 will apply in 10m. Notifying approvals channel.
sara: added release note stub: https://git.redwood/release-notes/3388 - "Temporarily route eu-west to runtime v3.1.9 due to SDK handshake regression for quant-llama3x long sequences. Will revert after SDK patch." Please review.
mike: LGTM. I will watch telemetry and have debug hooks ready.
julian: +1. If we see any Dedicated edgecases, ping me.
tina: :thumbsup: leaning on SDK team to speed PR review.
ops-bot: Action checklist: [x] pin request created P-9876, [ ] approvals received, [ ] pin applied, [ ] canary monitoring active, [ ] rollback criteria set.
lena: Approvals: mike + julian -> please post approves so deploybot can apply.
mike: approve
julian: approve
deploybot: Approvals confirmed. Applying P-9876 now.
sara: canary traffic routed. monitoring: embed error probe started. ETA 60m for stable signal.
ops-bot: Remember to update support docs and customer comms if we extend the pin beyond 48h.
lena: noted. Will coordinate with #customer-success if extension needed.
sara: quick note for postmortem: add the SDK PR id and the failing test case name (longseq-handshake-1500) in the ticket.
lena: thanks everyone. Will update thread with final status.
